integration_decision.name: HARDEN_TEST_HARNESS_IN_DISPOSABLE_OVERLAY_ONLY_BEFORE_EXPECTED_RED
integration_decision.new_source_verified_finding: The 112-line spawned preflight uses a shared Queue carrying full anata_output despite its compact-only task contract, and its A/B process cleanup is not enclosed in a whole-test finally: assertions between A join and B completion, or B Queue timeout, can bypass bounded cleanup. This is a concrete test-harness robustness gap, not evidence of a production race.
integration_decision.source_facts: The existing A child fully exits before rowB append and B start; runner.run_once reads archive once then writes latest.json, audit_latest.json and anata_latest.json in separate atomic replacements; ArchiveWriterLock only guards archive operations. A-paused/B-publishes/A-resumes remains unexecuted and unproven.
integration_decision.decision: Do not churn the reviewed expected-red oracle or enqueue malformed Gemini tasks. Require a disposable exact-SHA test-only harness with top-level spawn targets, compact result queues, one finally enclosing all children/events, bounded Queue get and joins, and forced terminate+join on failure. No production modifications.
integration_decision.no_network_test_contract: Use T=1700000000000; spawn A on empty shared tmpdir; intercept only runner.atomic_write_json(anata_latest.json) in child A, set A_paused and wait release_A with timeout; parent confirms A alive and paused; append rowB effective=T-2000, available=observed=T-1000; spawn B while A paused; require B exit=0, 1 archive/1 scoring, no errors and rowB provenance; snapshot bytes for latest.json, audit_latest.json, anata_latest.json; release A in finally; join/terminate both children bounded; compare final bytes and handoff provenance; classify STALE_HANDOFF_REPRODUCED/OTHER_MIXED_GENERATION/NO_OVERWRITE/INVALID_TEST. Collect pytest --collect-only, targeted and full Capital Flow exitcodes/logs separately; expected-red is not a PASS-only commit gate.
integration_decision.next: Obtain authorized exact-SHA disposable checkout or safe hosted read-only executable harness; execute and preserve regression and pytest evidence; request independent C review before any Gemini-only repair task.
